title: EC2 Fleet Management
description:
Epic for all plan 20 (EC2 Fleet Management) implementation work.

Plan document: docs/plans/20-fleet-management.md
Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Implements FleetSandboxControl which manages a fleet of EC2 instances with capacity-aware routing, automatic scaling, health checking, drain/recovery, and a 6-phase control loop. Each instance runs a NodeSandboxControl and the fleet routes CreateSandbox calls to the least-loaded instance.

Includes EC2InstanceProvisioner (concrete implementation of InstanceProvisioner for EC2), capacity-aware routing, and TLA+ formal specification.
